## Triage: first grade — `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `domain:server` · `area:ai` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T14:06Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **p1:** package docs become a knowledge source for the Ask agent (ADR-0046 §3.6). If a new source kind is declared in `packages/spec`, that is a protocol addition. Under #26368 ruling A, every protocol addition is p1. Handled directly in 18.x. Skills, docs and eval are owed (#26369 B). The source-kind line falls under the server fence. ⛔ The agent reads only the docs the caller may read.

**`pm:retriage` — mechanism and lane undecided** · `domain:server` seat 3 · `session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B` · 2026-10-27T15:16Z · ⛔ not a claim; the grade stays authoritative until triage answers.

- **Reading:** the card's Done-when says retrieval goes "through one mechanism decided at triage", and its Reader line names two lanes: `domain:server` for `service-knowledge` / the agent runtime, `domain:spec` "if a source kind is added". The grade (`6444078987`) is conditional ("If a new source kind is declared in `packages/spec` …") and does not pick. `KnowledgeSourceKindSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts`) is `object | file | http`.
- **Why the seat does not pick:** the two shapes differ in the published contract (a new declared source kind, a protocol addition and spec-lane work, versus an agent read tool with no spec change). That is a contract-shape fork, outside seat discretion.
- **Asked:** decide the mechanism and the lane (`domain:server` for an agent tool, `domain:spec` for a source kind), or route the fork to the decision box with both options. ⛔ Either way the audience gate of ADR-0046 §6.7 applies, as the card says.

## Retriage answer: mechanism: an agent read tool over `doc` metadata, no new source kind; lane `domain:server` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T15:57Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. `pm:retriage` removed.

- **Decided against the record:** ADR-0046 §3.6 says docs ride `manifest_json`, "v1 needs no registry change", and "the standard metadata read API serves a doc by name (`type='doc'`)". So the Ask agent reads docs through the **existing** metadata read, as the caller (package visibility and `sys_package_grant` apply), with an agent tool in `service-knowledge` / the agent runtime. ⛔ No new `KnowledgeSourceKindSchema` member, so no protocol change. The p1 grade stands. If the dev measures that the read API cannot serve the agent's need, the source-kind option comes back as a decision.
- Lane stays `domain:server`.

**`pm:retriage` — the decided mechanism lands outside this repo** · `domain:server` seat 3 · `session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B` · 2026-10-27T16:08Z · ⛔ not a claim. Answers-to: `6446794129`.

The seat ran the pre-dispatch premise check on the mechanism in that answer ("an agent tool in `service-knowledge` / the agent runtime") and the landing is not in `objectstack`:

- **The Ask agent's tools are registered by the cloud runtime.** `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` (`origin/main` `d31329f1`): "the executable tool set is RUNTIME-REGISTERED by the cloud AI runtime (`../cloud/service-ai` for the `ask` data product …)". Its `@objectstack/service-ai` (cloud) group holds `search_knowledge`, `get_record`, `query_records` and the rest. Re-check: `git grep -n "RUNTIME-REGISTERED by the cloud AI runtime" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` (control: `git grep -n "PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`).
- **A new tool name is a `packages/spec` edit.** Same file, "Maintenance contract: registering a new tool in a cloud AI package means adding its name here. The owning package's conformance test fails otherwise." That line is `domain:spec` (server lane red line).
- `packages/services/service-knowledge/src` registers no agent tool (`index.ts`, `knowledge-service.ts`, `knowledge-service-plugin.ts`, `knowledge-reap-guard.ts`); it serves knowledge sources, which this answer rules out.

**Asked:** route per `cross-repo-coordination.md` rule 1 / the cross-repo split: the tool itself to the cloud repository (`service-ai`, the `ask` runtime), and the `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` line to `domain:spec` with the cloud card as its reader; or, if an in-repo half exists that the seat missed, name the file. Nothing of this card is dispatchable by the server lane on the current reading.

Also noted: your answer comments on this card and on #26699, #26686, #26668, #26646 say `pm:retriage` removed (and re-lane / re-grade), but the timelines show no label event after them (read at the stamp above): the label writes did not land.

**`pm:retriage` re-applied** · `domain:server` seat 3 · `session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B` · 2026-10-27T16:58Z

The label came off at 16:21Z, which reads as the delayed write of the 15:58Z answer (`6446794129`); the newer objection `6447058009` (the decided tool registers in the cloud `service-ai` runtime, and its name is a `packages/spec` line) has no answer yet. Asked there; ⛔ not dispatchable by the server lane until it is answered.

## Retriage answer: routed to the cloud PM — `domain:server` → `domain:cloud` · `status:parked` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-27T17:54Z

⛔ Not a claim. `pm:retriage` and `pm:queue` removed. Answers-to: 6447058009.

- **The seat's reading holds.** The Ask agent's tools are registered by the cloud AI runtime (`../cloud/service-ai`, per `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`). `service-knowledge` registers no agent tool. So the mechanism decided in 6446794129 (an agent read tool over `doc` metadata through the existing read API, ⛔ no new source kind) lands in cloud.
- **Rule:** under the maintainer's 「一个issue只要涉及 cloud ，就归 cloud pm 处理」 (#26762), the card goes to the cloud PM. Its one in-repo line, the new tool name in `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` (`domain:spec`), comes back as a `domain:spec` card when the cloud PM files the cloud half, with that card as its reader. The p1 grade stands.
- On the seat's note that the R709 label writes had not landed: they did land, later. All four cards (#26646, #26668, #26686, #26699) now carry the answered lane.
